#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=bowtie
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=10G
#SBATCH --time=2:00:00
#SBATCH --output=./logs/%x_%a.out
#SBATCH --error=./logs/%x_%a.err

basdir=/lisc/data/scratch/admixlab/
cd $basdir/mk_data/mummy/bact/GCA_031163315.1_ASM3116331v1

module load Bowtie2 SAMtools

REF=GCA_031163315.1_ASM3116331v1_genomic.fna
SAMDIR=$basdir/shan/RNAvirus/human/deeper/368901/368901
SAMPLE=368901

bowtie2-build "$REF" LBC_index

bowtie2 \
  -x LBC_index \
  -1 ${SAMDIR}_1_cutadapt.fastq.gz \
  -2 ${SAMDIR}_1_cutadapt.fastq.gz \
  --very-sensitive \
  --end-to-end \
  --dovetail \
  --no-discordant \
  -p 8 \
  2> ${SAMPLE}.LBC.log | 
samtools sort -@ 8 -o $basdir/mk_data/mummy/bact/${SAMPLE}.LBC.sorted.bam

samtools index $basdir/mk_data/mummy/bact/${SAMPLE}.LBC.sorted.bam

exit
